issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing getters for each attribute (public access), but the solution implementation declares some getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This contradicts the specification and will confuse students and break tests that expect public getters for every attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public (in particular getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()) so their visibility matches the problem specification and expected tests. Update the solution (and ensure the template's examples or comments reflect these public signatures).
